easymine.command.help.title: Easy Mine commands:
easymine.command.help.stop: /em stop - stop recording, or deselect the playing route
easymine.command.help.status: /em status - show recording and playback state
easymine.command.help.select: /em select <name> - select a route (hold left click or use the play/pause key)
easymine.command.help.block: /em block <here|set <block>|clear|check <start|always>> <name> - only play a route while standing on a block
easymine.play.busy_recording: Finish recording before selecting a route.
easymine.play.selected: Selected route: %s. Start it with left click or the play/pause key.
easymine.block.title: Stand-on block
easymine.block.here: Use the block I'm standing on
easymine.block.check_start.short: checked at the start of each loop
easymine.block.check_start.tooltip:
Checked when the route starts and each time it loops back to the beginning.
Once running, the route keeps playing wherever it walks.
easymine.block.check_always.tooltip:
Checked every tick: the route pauses whenever you are not on that block
and carries on when you are back on it.
easymine.block.no_block_set: "%s" has no stand-on block yet. Set one first.
easymine.record.error.name_too_long: Route names can be at most %s characters.
easymine.screen.title: Easy Mine
easymine.screen.name: Route name
easymine.screen.background.tooltip:
Keeps a route playing after you alt-tab or minimize the game, instead of Minecraft pausing it.
Start the route with the play/pause key: left click cannot be held while tabbed out.
easymine.screen.block.tooltip_none: Stand-on block: none (plays anywhere). Click to set one.
easymine.screen.block.tooltip: Plays only on: %s. Click to change.
easymine.screen.hint.hold: Hold left click to play the route
easymine.screen.hint.both: Hold left click or press %s to play
